name: Auto parts sales
summary: Sell parts over the counter with RobOS Point of Sale: barcode scanning, cash drawer, card and cash payments, receipts and sales reports, in its own window.
roadmap: Share one stock count with Orders → Stock, so parts sold at the counter and parts used on repairs come off the same shelf

Sell a part straight onto a repair ticket
Core charges and returns of old parts
